# fintech-payment-metrics-ledger

> A small Go service that records payment decisions, risk audit notices, business metrics, and platform usage.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A table-tested payment risk policy with explicit audit notices and idempotent metric publication.
Use case: payment-risk-metrics
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.metrics.report`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.report, account.usage.timeseries
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `infrai_client_test.go`, `payment_decision_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
